Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 132. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 8 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
As quick spin-attack against all creatures in your
reach. All creatures within range must make a Dexterity
saving throw or take your melee weapon’s damage die +
1d10, half on a success.
